derivation.source_filter: Country=Switzerland AND League=Super League AND Season in 2018/2019..2025/2026; 2 Challenge League rows (2020/2021) + 9 Barrage rows excluded
derivation.identity_rule: regular-season team set per season taken from Q1 fixtures (10 teams 2018/19-2022/23, 12 teams 2023/24-2025/26)
derivation.kickoff_rule: pre-match snapshot = standings from all COMPLETED league matches with kickoff strictly before this fixture kickoff (Date+Time, Europe/Zurich); fixtures sharing identical kickoff timestamp mutually excluded (conservative, documented)
derivation.rank_rule: DERIVED: sorted by points desc, then goal difference desc, then goals scored desc; ties share rank (competition ranking 1,2,2,4). SFL official tie-breakers (e.g. head-to-head) may differ - rank is not official
derivation.unplayed_rule: fixtures not yet played -> all snapshot fields NULL with reason
derivation.score_fields: HG/AG/Res used internally for computation only; NO score/result fields in output (verified by leak scan)
